description: Fires mostly in the opening, on a fixed bottom-centre-right pattern: my stones at (0,4) and/or (0,5) hemmed in by opponent stones, especially an opponent stone directly on top of my column-5 bottom stone, and opponent stones at (0,2)/(0,3)/(1,2)/(1,3) to the left of my (0,4). My own stones at (0,6), (0,1) or in rows 1-2 of columns 2-5 suppress it. Not translation- or mirror-invariant. Weaker late-game firing is diffuse and not captured.
effect: Small and context-dependent: at its strongest positions it moves about 0.1-0.17 probability from column 3 toward columns 1-2; it does about nothing elsewhere.
notes: The strong early-game template is solid under minimal pairs (O on (1,5) over my (0,5); O at (0,2),(0,3),(1,3) next to my (0,4); my nearby stones suppress it; tied to absolute cells). Best dev F1 0.259 (P 0.19, R 0.40, AUROC 0.67), simulation share 0.16. Most misses are weak (around 1.0-1.4) late-game firing with no single clear trigger; this looks like a mixture or a distributed feature. Calls 1-2 were one program run twice by mistake.
